findings.name: Form Boundary 1: Empty Input Handling
findings.detail: All fields validate non-empty trimmed strings correctly.

findings.name: Form Boundary 2: Email Regex Validation
findings.detail: Standard invalid emails rejected. Double-dot email 'user@domain..com' regex match result: true

findings.name: Projects Boundary 3: Rapid Filter Button Click Async Race Condition
findings.detail: renderGrid uses setTimeout(..., 200) without clearTimeout/debouncing. Rapid clicks cause multiple stacked renders.

findings.name: Canvas Boundary 4: Window Resize Event Handling
findings.detail: Window resize listener correctly updates aspect ratio and renderer size.

findings.name: Performance Metric 1: WebGL Frame Loop Overhead & Tab Visibility Pause
findings.detail: Frame loop evaluates 7140 particle distance pairs per frame at 60fps. Tab visibility listener correctly pauses animationFrame when hidden.

findings.name: Performance Metric 2: WebGL Scene Event Listener Cleanup
findings.detail: initBackgroundScene provides destroy() method that removes all window/document listeners and disposes renderer.

findings.name: Performance Metric 3: Canvas CSS z-index & pointer-events
findings.detail: #bg-canvas correctly has position: fixed, z-index: -1, and pointer-events: none ensuring UI accessibility and background rendering.
